proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Successive reductions put u into a quasi-affine reduced U carrying a dense invariant open W on which the restrictions of s and t are finite locally free. Two applications of the almost-invariant-function lemma produce invariant affine opens, one inside W containing the finitely many generic points above the orbit and one inside the reduced closed complement Z containing u. The norm, invariant by the determinant trick, of the pullback of the second function gives an invariant function g on W, and the union V of the g-open part of the first affine open with the second piece is shown open by constructibility plus an explicit generalization chase, invariant by construction, and affine by the get-affine criterion, finishing the proof. (source lines 3034-3167)

core_obligations: Reduce in three steps (proof lines 3034-3057): the finite orbit of u lands in an affine open U' by varieties-proposition-finite-set-of-points-of-codim-1-in-affine (tag 09NN); removing the invariant closed subset image of the orbit preimage of the complement makes U quasi-affine; reduction and replacement by the closure of the invariant dense open W from lemma-finite-flat-over-almost-dense-subscheme (transferred via lemma-find-affine-integral) leave U quasi-affine reduced with s_W, t_W finite locally free. If u lies in W, lemma-find-invariant-affine (tag 03JE) with the quasi-affineness input properties-lemma-ample-finite-set-in-affine (tag 01ZY) finishes (proof lines 3059-3064). Otherwise the orbit misses W; a point specializing into the orbit is not in the orbit by lemma-no-specializations-map-to-same-point, hence is generic by assumption (3), and Noetherianity leaves finitely many such points xi_j in W whose orbits are generic, by flatness of s_W, t_W (proof lines 3065-3076). Two applications of lemma-find-almost-invariant-function produce f with the preimage of its principal open an invariant affine open inside W containing all xi_j, and h with the intersection of its principal open preimage with Z an invariant affine open containing u, where Z is the reduced closed complement of the first affine open (proof lines 3079-3113). Set g the norm of the pullback of h, invariant by lemma-determinant-trick (tag 03BH) (proof lines 3115-3123). The set V, the union of the g-open part of the first affine open with the Z-piece, is set theoretically invariant by construction; openness follows from constructibility plus the generalization chase on specializations u_1 above u_2 with u_2 in the Z-piece (topology lemmas tags 0542 and 0903; proof lines 3124-3150), which uses finiteness of s to lift the specialization to arrows r_1 above r_2 and contradicts invariance of the Z-piece. Finally V lies inside the h-principal open, giving an immersion into the affine scheme A_h localized; the g-part is the principal open of the affine first piece determined by g, the Z-part meets the principal closed part in a closed subset by the choice of h in I, and lemma-get-affine concludes V is affine (proof lines 3152-3167).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a quasi-affine reduced U with a dense invariant W carrying finite locally free s_W, t_W (proof lines 3034-3057).
Handle u in W by lemma-find-invariant-affine; otherwise collect the finitely many generic points xi_j above the orbit (proof lines 3059-3076).
Apply lemma-find-almost-invariant-function twice to get invariant affine opens in W (function f) and in the closed complement Z (function h) (proof lines 3079-3113).
Glue the pieces using the invariant norm g and prove openness of V by the explicit generalization chase (proof lines 3115-3150).
Conclude affineness of V from the immersion into the localized affine scheme and lemma-get-affine (proof lines 3152-3167).
